riskClasses.meaning: Tenant-private read, digest, or internal-task preparation with no customer, provider, financial, or upstream mutation effect.
A request for an owner decision; the request never stands in for the decision and never executes the proposed effect.
Customer-facing words or channel activity that can create privacy, consent, spam, harassment, or reputation harm.
Delivery of an exact customer-safe document or scoped access link with confidentiality, revision, recipient, expiry, and revocation risk.
Communication about an exact current financial fact; it cannot charge, refund, assess fees, write off, settle, or alter accounting.
Human-controlled collection attention or communication with elevated harassment, privacy, stale-balance, legal-claim, and escalation risk.
Upstream business-fact mutation, money movement, charging, refunds, fees, write-offs, settlement, accounting mutation, or unsupported external enforcement is outside Mission 28 authority.

threats.definition: A permitted-looking action is used excessively, deceptively, coercively, or outside its reviewed business purpose.
threats.failClosedBoundary: No action proceeds without exact bounded purpose, owner authority, limits, and evidence; Part 1C grants none.

threats.definition: Customer, tenant, staff, document, provider, or financial data is exposed to an unnecessary party, surface, log, prompt, or channel.
threats.failClosedBoundary: Minimize data and deny when recipient, projection, tenant, record, channel, or retention authority is missing or ambiguous.

threats.definition: A fact, callback, staff role, provider, legacy surface, or caller causes NorthStar to exercise authority it does not own.
threats.failClosedBoundary: Bind exact actor, tenant, capability, policy, source, recipient, action, and effect; no input or provider label grants authority.

threats.definition: Duplicate, excessive, unwanted, or insufficiently authorized owner/customer communication is attempted.
threats.failClosedBoundary: No communication support exists until later exact permission, suppression, frequency, idempotency, and channel controls are accepted.

threats.definition: Cadence, tone, timing, channel, or escalation pressures or repeatedly contacts a person contrary to policy or current facts.
threats.failClosedBoundary: Unknown permission, quiet hours, suppression, dispute, human activity, or escalation basis blocks the action.

threats.definition: A prior request, approval, event, callback, preview, evidence item, or action identity is reused to duplicate or widen an effect.
threats.failClosedBoundary: Later work must bind single-use or standing authority, current source and policy digests, idempotency, and reconciliation; Part 1C executes nothing.

threats.definition: Identity, source, recipient, policy, document, evidence, or provider state from one tenant is read or used for another.
threats.failClosedBoundary: Every future read and effect must bind one exact tenant and fail closed on aliases, guesses, cache reuse, or mixed snapshots.

threats.definition: An action is based on a corrected, superseded, paid, disputed, revoked, reopened, deleted, or otherwise non-current source.
threats.failClosedBoundary: Exact source version/digest/currentness must be checked at evaluation and again immediately before effect.

threats.definition: Stored, supplied, generated, or provider-returned content attempts to alter instructions, authority, recipients, actions, claims, or evidence.
threats.failClosedBoundary: Content is data only; bounded templates and customer-safe projection cannot grant or widen authority.

threats.definition: Provider availability, identity, mode, credentials, acknowledgements, callbacks, retries, or corrections are missing, forged, stale, or misunderstood.
threats.failClosedBoundary: Provider-neutral capability and evidence remain unavailable until later accepted work; provider state never grants action authority.

threats.definition: Cost, size, fan-out, cadence, parsing, scheduling, retry, queue, recipient, or provider behavior exhausts tenant or system resources.
threats.failClosedBoundary: Later work must enforce deterministic bounds, quotas, backpressure, deadlines, circuit breaking, and tenant isolation before execution.

actionFamilies.label: Internal read, digest, or task
actionFamilies.effectBoundary: May later read accepted tenant-private facts and prepare a bounded internal digest or task; it may not contact a customer/provider, mutate upstream truth, or create a financial effect.

actionFamilies.label: Owner approval request
actionFamilies.effectBoundary: May later ask an exact authorized owner to decide on one exact preview; requesting, viewing, or acknowledging approval never executes the proposed downstream action.

actionFamilies.label: Customer communication
actionFamilies.effectBoundary: May later send only an approved bounded message to one exact current authorized recipient/channel; no delivery, reply, outcome, business-fact, or provider claim is inferred.

actionFamilies.label: Secure document delivery
actionFamilies.owner: Mission 28 approved document-delivery policy over upstream-owned documents
actionFamilies.effectBoundary: May later deliver one exact current customer-safe upstream-owned document or scoped link; it cannot edit the document, widen access, or treat handoff/open/view as acceptance or payment.

actionFamilies.label: Financial reminder
actionFamilies.owner: Mission 28 approved reminder policy over Mission 27 financial facts
actionFamilies.effectBoundary: May later communicate one exact current issued invoice, due date, balance, payment option, receipt, credit, refund, or dispute fact; it cannot charge, refund, assess fees, write off, settle, collect, or alter accounting.

actionFamilies.label: Collection escalation
actionFamilies.owner: Mission 28 human-controlled collection communication policy over Mission 27 reviewed handoff
actionFamilies.effectBoundary: May later create a graduated owner work item or explicitly reviewed customer communication from one exact current Mission 27 collection handoff; no legal threat, agency referral, fee, credit action, enforcement, or automatic financial effect is authorized.

actionFamilies.label: Unsupported upstream mutation or money movement
actionFamilies.effectBoundary: Always deny upstream schedule, work, estimate, invoice, balance, payment, settlement, refund, fee, write-off, accounting, legal, provider-account, or money mutation and any equivalent indirect request.

part1BDispositionPolicy.boundary: A reusable surface remains inactive and grants no action, launch, recipient, channel, provider, or effect authority.
It may be consumed only through its existing accepted contract and cannot become Mission 28 action authority.
It cannot cross into paid data, real recipients, provider credentials, money, or effect evidence.
Legacy code is not an adapter, trigger, action, evidence, or fallback authority.
Opening or preparing a native/manual handoff is not an automated attempt, sent/delivered effect, or outcome.
Ambiguity blocks reuse until a later independently accepted authority resolves it.

unsupportedCombinations.condition: Action family is missing, renamed, unknown, duplicated, or structurally malformed.
Caller treats this catalog or implementation-candidate status as launch or execution permission.
An event, fact, elapsed time, prediction, recommendation, label, callback, or evidence item is treated as action permission.
Tenant, actor, policy, source, recipient, document, provider, action, or evidence binding differs or is unknown.
Source, policy, recipient, consent, suppression, limit, document, balance, or evidence is stale, corrected, mixed-revision, unavailable, or unverified.
Approval, request, preview, event, action, provider attempt, callback, or evidence identity is replayed, duplicated, aliased, or unreconciled.
Prompt, stored text, generated content, template variable, provider response, callback, or transport state attempts to grant or widen authority.
A quarantined, ambiguous, simulated, upstream-owned, excluded, or manual Part 1B surface is treated as reusable execution authority.
An internal read, digest, or task requests customer/provider contact, document delivery, financial communication, upstream mutation, or money effect.
Creating, viewing, delivering, or acknowledging an approval request executes or schedules its proposed downstream action.
Sender, recipient, relationship, channel, permission, suppression, content, cadence, currentness, or owner authority is absent or ambiguous.
Document owner, customer-safe projection, revision/digest, recipient, access scope, expiry, revocation, privacy, or delivery authority is absent or ambiguous.
Reminder requests a charge, refund, fee, write-off, settlement, payout, balance, accounting, or other money/business-fact mutation.
Reviewed handoff is absent or the action adds a legal threat, unsupported deadline/fee, agency/credit referral, harassment, enforcement, or automatic financial effect.
Any direct, indirect, aliased, provider-mediated, callback-mediated, or evidence-mediated upstream mutation is requested.
Any direct, indirect, aliased, provider-mediated, callback-mediated, or evidence-mediated movement or reclassification of money is requested.

unavailableEvidence: Part 1C independent audit, PR, merge, deployment, and release
Part 1D launch matrix or any supported first-launch action
Production provider accounts, credentials, senders, callbacks, templates, capability, sandbox, or deliverability
Real recipients, messages, document delivery, replies, collection activity, financial effects, or live money
Professional legal, privacy, communications-consent, collections, debt, consumer-protection, provider, or security opinion
Private-production customer evidence, hosted load or SLA, disaster restore, physical Safari/devices, manual assistive-technology review, or founder visual approval
